description: This file defines database migration scripts for an Android app using Room persistence library. It includes migration objects for transitioning database schema from version 1 to 2 and from version 2 to 3, involving adding columns, creating a new table, copying data, and creating indexes.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Abstract class representing a database migration in Room.

methods.name: migrate
methods.description: Method to execute migration SQL commands during schema upgrade.
